verdict.rationale: macOS's own docs offer task automation through Shortcuts and a multi-file 'Combine files into a PDF' operation, which hint at acting on many items at once. Neither is described as a general bulk-operation capability. missing for 10: explicit documentation of batch actions across many files or items (e.g. batch rename or bulk processing via Shortcuts), detail on the scope and limits of bulk automation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
